fato_historico: 1997: Sixteen people are killed when Formosa Airlines Flight 7601 crashes near Beigan Airport in the Matsu Islands of Taiwan.
energia_do_dia: Today, consider how delicate and precious the threads of life are. Just as the winds change near distant islands, your path may experience unexpected shifts. It is a good time to cherish your milestones and ground your ambitions in gratitude. Trust that your steady nature provides the shelter you need to navigate any breeze with quiet grace.
frase_do_dia: Hold your dreams close and cherish every step of your beautiful journey.
significado_numero: Represents the path of transformation and finding light within complex transitions.
conselho: Focus on the present moment and nurture your connections with deep, sincere kindness.
